basis.projection: Sleeper 2026 projected stat lines re-scored with the league's exact scoring_settings (data/raw/league-2026.json) — the same numbers the draft board runs on.
basis.market: ADP and Boris Chen tiers come from the shared draft board, which is built in this league's reception value.
basis.lineup: Optimal lineup under QB/RB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX/FLEX/K/DEF, five bench. Greedy is optimal here because slot eligibility nests.
basis.strength: Per-slot and per-position rank against the other nine teams. K and DEF are reported but never graded — they are streaming positions in this format.
basis.surplus: A bench player's "starts on N" is measured by recomputing each of the other nine optimal lineups with him inserted.
basis.trades: Exhaustive 1-for-1 and 2-for-1 search. A proposal ships only if BOTH optimal lineups rise (>= 5 season points for a 1-for-1; >= 8 to me and >= 5 to them for a 2-for-1, where the other side must also take on more raw projected points than it gives).
basis.tendencies: Parsed from league-tendencies.md; trade counts recomputed from data/raw/transactions-2020..2025.json.
basis.caveat: A projection is a season-long point estimate. It cannot see a camp role change, it prices DEF poorly (points-allowed tiers do not project), and it says nothing about week-to-week ceiling. Every number here is the start of an argument, not the end of one.

week.schedule_source: pairings from Sleeper's regular-season schedule, kickoff times from ESPN's public scoreboard
week.projection_source: Sleeper week-8 projected stat lines re-scored with The HBGBs's exact scoring_settings — the same arithmetic as the season column, over a different stat line.
week.result_source: The HBGBs's own week-8 matchup rows — Sleeper's scoring of each player in this league's settings, read as published rather than recomputed here.

basis.standing: Results from The HBGBs's own weekly matchup rows, final weeks only (every game marked complete by ESPN). Seeded by wins, then points for; 6 of 10 make the playoffs.
basis.strength: Rank of the optimal starting lineup on season projections, the same number the roster room grades.
basis.no_blend: Standing and strength are read separately, never blended. On HBGBs 2020-25, results added almost nothing to the projection as a predictor of rest-of-season scoring (leakage-free k = 51.08; see data/perf-k.json).
basis.all_play: Your record had you played every other team each week: the schedule-luck check.
basis.proj_gap: Skill starters' (QB/RB/WR/TE) scored points against their pre-week projections in this league's scoring. K and DEF are left out: DEF points-allowed tiers never project, so they would book a structural gap as luck.
basis.efficiency: Hindsight-optimal lineup from everyone rostered that week, scored by Sleeper, against what the started lineup scored.
basis.byes: Replacement-aware: the loss after the better of your bench and one free-agent pickup, per game on season projections. Flagged at or above 6.1 a game, this league's 75th percentile. Window: the next 3 unplayed week(s), plus weeks 13-14 pinned until the week-12 deadline. Availability designations are not applied to future weeks.
basis.actions: Routed, never generated: each one is lifted from this league's published waiver board or this build's trade search. When neither addresses a gap, the line says so.
basis.blind_spots: A free agent the waiver board does not list at all, beating the best routed action for the same gap by at least 5 season points (0.3 a game). Named as a gap in the board, not recommended.

usage_risers.basis: Unrostered in The HBGBs, not listed Out/IR, and at or above this league's median rostered player at his position (RB touch share, WR target share, TE target share; QBs are left to judgment, since most starters go unrostered in a one-QB league) on his last completed week or his last-3-week window. Top 6 per position by margin over that median. Snap share stands in for routes, which Sleeper does not publish.
